svg.text: PROGRAMS AND NODES: A FRAME IS ITS BLOCK
The same table of colours as hardware's: a block's by its kind, its ports' by their group, in ENGINE and on the rack.
KINDS OF BLOCK: A COLOUR EACH
By media.class, whoever owns the block: a program's virtual sink is a sink. Who owns it is the device's paint (aluminium, black, olive).
a card's output; a program's virtual sink
a mic; a program's virtual source
the ALSA MIDI bridge, BLE MIDI
in and out alike: Bitwig, a JACK app
Easy Effects' effects, its test signal
GROUPS OF PORTS: SEVEN, AND OTHER

PLAYBACK, CAPTURE, INPUT, OUTPUT, MONITOR, MIDI, VIDEO; OTHER for a format not known (NO CLASS's sand). A group: the ports of one direction and one kind (monitor or not, audio, MIDI, video); on a MIDI bridge, of one client.
Not port.group: Easy Effects puts each channel in a group of its own (stream.0 for FL, stream.1 for FR).
TEAMS FOR LINUX · ITS RECORDING STREAM
A recording stream: green. Its groups: the input (green) and its monitor (violet), like a sink's.
TEAMS FOR LINUX · ONE OF ITS FIVE PLAYBACK STREAMS
A playback stream: rust, its one group too. Five of them, numbered (OUTPUT 1…5) as now.
A program's virtual sink is a sink: teal, like a card's. The paint (black) says whose it is.
A virtual source is a source: blue. Its groups: what is fed in (green), and what apps record (blue; PipeWire flags these port.monitor).
PipeWire gives it no class: sand, lettered dark. Its groups keep their colours: the input green, the output rust.
A duplex block: magenta. Its input green, its output rust.
One block, two groups each way, a group a client (MIDI Through, Hydrogen): the same kind of port, the same colour; their names tell them apart.
· Kinds of block: eight, a colour each: SINK, SOURCE, PLAYBACK STREAM, RECORDING STREAM, MIDI, VIDEO, and DUPLEX (magenta #73348d),
NO CLASS (sand #cba553, lettered dark: kinds.py, variant 4). One outline, never dashed.
· Groups of ports: the seven colours we have cover every port. Two groups of one kind in one block (a bridge's clients) share their colour; their names tell them apart.
· The kind is by media.class, never by owner: a program's sink is teal like a card's; the paint tells them apart (black, aluminium).
· ENGINE: blocks by kind and ports by group, as the rack. Its SYSTEM colour goes: PipeWire's own nodes are told by their paint on the rack.
· GRAPH, on the band before the name, with its node's id: ENGINE opens with that block chosen (in the LCD's amber) and in view. No animation.
